subject: Trading
title: News Trading
description: Learn News Trading in one minute.

hook.text: Non-Farm Payrolls drops at 8:30 AM Eastern. In the next 30 seconds, EUR/USD can move 100 pips.

buildup.text: Economic releases—jobs, CPI, GDP—create instant volatility as algorithms and traders react simultaneously.

discovery.text: The market doesn't react to the number itself—it reacts to the surprise versus consensus expectations.

twist.text: Spreads blow out during releases. Slippage can turn a winning idea into a losing trade before you blink.

climax.text: News trading is fast, volatile, and unforgiving. The edge goes to those who best predict the deviation.

punchline.text: The number doesn't matter. The surprise does.

quiz.question: What drives price reaction during economic data releases?
options: The difference between actual data and market expectations
